map.name: Vulkir
map.trouble: Malgrith the Ember Witch has turned the Fire Imps of Mount Skarn against the forges of Vulkir.

bounty_offer.specifics: Dagrun the armorer wants the Beetles of the Beetle Nest gone and her lost ore-carter Pellock found.

offer.speaker: Dagrun
offer.text:
Filthy chewing pests! The Beetles crawled up out of the cinder caves only this month and they're already into everything!

I'm Dagrun the armorer. It's my ore-carter Pellock I'm after. I'm afraid that Beetle Nest has swallowed him up.

Find him for me and I'll see you're well paid. Follow me, I'll point you to that miserable nest beside the slag heaps.

reminder.speaker: Dagrun
reminder.text: Any sign of Pellock? Oh my, I can't bear to think of it.

completion.speaker: Dagrun
completion.text:
Pellock's leather cap! The poor fellow must have met a bad end.

Those Beetles didn't stand a chance against you, that's plain. Maybe you've got the arms for smithing. Hmmm... Could be.

Come by my shop. There's a pair of boots on the bench with your name on it, and some gold too. The guild will have more work for you before long.

journal.text: Learn what happened to Pellock in the Beetle Nest.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Old Muldo the smith cannot work his forge since the Cinder Gang stole his fire gloves.

offer.speaker: Muldo
offer.text:
Aaaagh! Back! Don't hurt me!

Huh. Just a traveler?! My nerves are in pieces. Still, you don't look like those rotten thieves of the Cinder Gang who took my fire gloves! I can't go near my forge without them.

Fetch them back and you'll have saved an old man's trade. Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Muldo
refusal.text: Oh.... I see. Well, I won't keep you then.

reminder.speaker: Muldo
reminder.text: Got my gloves back?! No?.... Well, that gang hides out in the old quarry west of town.

completion.speaker: Muldo
completion.text: You found my gloves! Bless you, bless you! Now take this spellbook along with my thanks. Everything I ever learned about fire is written in it. Any traveler would be glad of it.

after.speaker: Muldo
after.text: A hundred thanks for my gloves! The forge is roaring again!

journal.text: Recover Muldo's fire gloves from the Cinder Gang.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Muldo's fire gloves from the Cinder Gang.

two_givers.specifics: Guildmaster Thorva sells her finest blade cheap before leaving town; Grubble at the Red Bellows wants 9,000 gold for his anvil and his mule.

offer_a.speaker: Thorva
offer_a.text: With the Ember Witch about, hardly anyone orders a sword these days. Before I pack up for the coast, I'd let my finest blade go cheap.

offer_b.speaker: Grubble
offer_b.text: Fancy buying my anvil and my mule? Just 9,000 gold for the pair of 'em!

outcome_a.speaker: Thorva
outcome_a.text: Wonderful! A steal at that price, lad! Now I'd best load my cart, the coast is a long way off. Mind you keep clear of the Ember Witch, and I hope you come through all this in one piece. Farewell!

outcome_b.speaker: Grubble
outcome_b.text: Ah, no harm done. Somebody else will want an anvil and a mule, I'm sure. Should you think better of it, I'll be at the Red Bellows!

journal_a.text: Buy Thorva's blade before she leaves Vulkir.

journal_b.text: Hear out Grubble's offer at the Red Bellows.

rescue.specifics: Mayor Bolgrim begs the player to bring his nephew Tobble back from the Imps in the old smelter.

plea.speaker: Bolgrim
plea.text:
Those wretched Imps will be the death of this town! My guards drove them off, and back they came the very next night! They've carried off my nephew Tobble, and you're the only one who can bring him home!

They took him into the old smelter, over there behind the east wall. Please, watch yourself.

reminder.speaker: Bolgrim
reminder.text: I won't set foot outside till Tobble is home! Get into that smelter! Find the boy! Hurry, before those Imps do something dreadful!

found.speaker: Tobble
found.text: Is somebody there? Please, get me out of here!

following.speaker: Tobble
following.text: Hurry! Take me back to my uncle!

completion.speaker: Bolgrim
completion.text:
Brave Adventurer, you have my heartfelt thanks! You've earned the town's trust. I'll tell the guards you may cross the North Bridge whenever you please.

This gold is yours for your trouble. Please, take it!

journal.text: Rescue Mayor Bolgrim's nephew from the old smelter.

main_opening.specifics: Ostrid points the player to Forgemaster Odrik, who sends him with the Ember Blade to the Keepers of the Anvil in the Old Kiln.

herald.speaker: Ostrid
herald.text: I've heard Forgemaster Odrik is waiting on some stranger Kessick sent him. Odd times we're living in.

opening.speaker: Odrik
opening.text:
Ah, Kessick's friend. Odrik, Forgemaster to the smiths of Vulkir. At last my Ember Blade is ready to meet the Ember Witch! Only the Keepers of the Anvil can bless it, and they keep to the Old Kiln.

This key will open the iron gate on the mountain road. Take the blade to the kiln and talk with the Keepers.

reminder.speaker: Odrik
reminder.text:
Malgrith has to be beaten! It's YOU who holds the blade that can finish her!

Off you go! There's no time to lose.

journal.text: Find the Keepers of the Anvil in the Old Kiln.
